milestone: Board approval 2025-09-11
position_start: Appraisal-stage project information document dated 2025-01-20, status pipeline, expected approval 2025-03-27
position_end: Board-approved grant of SDR 73.9 million, about US$100 million equivalent, in a US$120 million total operation cost including US$20 million commercial financing, implemented by the state ICT institute and closing 2030-10-31; components are broadband US$50m, interoperable and secure platforms US$38m, skills US$5m and management US$7m
sources: 2025-01-20 PID Appraisal Stage - Digital Zambia Acceleration Project (P505094)|2025-09-11 DZAP World Bank PAD|2026-01-05 Zambia programs national digital ID rollout for year-end
note: The fifth operation of a multiphase regional programme with a US$2.48bn envelope across 15 countries; expected disbursement in the lender's FY2026 is US$6 million

subject: finance.new
name: Improved Rural Connectivity Project
milestone: Stated closing date of 2025-12-31
position_start: US$200,000,000 committed in 2017, of which US$141,100,654 disbursed, status active
position_end: Same amounts; the held record gives a closing date of 2025-12-31 while also carrying status active as enriched on 2026-07-21, and no source confirms closure or a final disbursement
note: The record's implementing agency is the National Road Fund Agency, which does not sit easily with the broadband description; treat as suspect before using as evidence of digital financing

subject: finance.new
name: Lupiya digital lending
milestone: Tenth anniversary announcement
position_start: The base carries no earlier position on the lender
position_end: More than K500 million lent to over 120,000 customers since founding, operating in all ten provinces and two other African countries, with a further K500 million committed over the next decade targeting small businesses, farmers, traders and women entrepreneurs
note: A forward lending intention by the lender itself, with no external financier or named recipient

subject: finance.new
name: Zambia Refugee and Host Communities Project
milestone: Became effective 2024-12-23
position_start: A US$30 million grant under the host communities and refugees window, board-approved 2024-09-26 and effective 2024-12-23, with agency technical support and the home affairs ministry as manager
position_end: Unchanged; a US$6 million identity limb issues biometric registration cards to refugees and former refugees and enrols them into the national register, with completion planned for end-October 2028
sources: 2024-09-27-world-bank-zambia-refugee-host-communities-grant|2025-10-03 Zambia plans domestic digital ID development with help from international partners
note: No disbursement figure, enrolment count or implementation progress within the window is held
